name: 10989 · Vly Cottage, NY
findings: ZIP 10989 (Vly Cottage) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10989 (Vly Cottage) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10989 (Vly Cottage) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
